basics.meta: Professional cleaners serving Salford and Greater Manchester. Guaranteed end of tenancy cleans, office cleaning, and deep cleaning. Book in 60 seconds.
basics.description: From luxury apartments at Salford Quays to bustling office spaces in the city centre, Cleaniq Services provides dependable, high-quality cleaning across Salford. Enjoy our 5-star guaranteed results.
services: End of Tenancy Cleaning in Salford

intro: Salford is really several places in one: waterside apartments at Salford Quays and MediaCityUK, Victorian terraces in Pendleton and Seedley, family homes in Swinton, Eccles and Worsley, and student houses close to the University of Salford.

That variety means our Salford cleaners do a bit of everything, from regular cleans for busy professionals at the Quays to deep cleans for family homes and end of tenancy cleans when student and rental tenancies finish.

popular.why: Student and rental tenancies near the university end in summer, and deposits depend on a proper clean.
Busy households in Swinton, Eccles and Worsley keep on top of things with weekly or fortnightly visits.
Older terraced houses in Pendleton and Seedley often need a top-to-bottom reset.

goodToKnow: End of tenancy dates for student houses cluster in June and July, so book early.
Quays apartments with glass balconies and big windows are worth adding to a deep clean.
Family homes in Worsley and Swinton often suit a fortnightly regular clean.
Tell us about parking permits or visitor bays near your home when you book.

faqs.q: Do you clean apartments at Salford Quays and MediaCityUK?
faqs.a: Yes. Our cleaners look after apartments across Salford Quays and MediaCityUK, including regular cleans, deep cleans and end of tenancy cleans.

faqs.q: Can you clean a student house in Salford at the end of a tenancy?
faqs.a: Yes. One end of tenancy clean can cover the whole shared house, including the kitchen, bathrooms and every bedroom. Book early for June and July.

faqs.q: Do you cover Eccles, Swinton and Worsley?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Salford cleaners cover Eccles, Swinton, Worsley, Walkden and the rest of the city of Salford.
